第25章 最强歌王系统（第1页）
过了一会儿后，陈晓云的哭声也渐渐小了，姬云生这才笑着问道：“姐姐，你们是来找我有什么事吗？本来我也打算回去了，要是事情急的话，那就先去办事好了。”陈晓云一听，抬起头后，擦了擦眼角的泪水，温柔笑着回答道：“弟弟，你是不是忘了，
今天说好的给你准备生辰的日子呀？”姬云生一听愣了下，笑着尴尬回答道：“呃，姐姐，我的确给忘了。不过，姐姐，生辰这事就算了吧！我都多大的人了，没必要每年都要过的。”三女一听顿时齐声温柔说道：“不行！”姬云生一听摇摇头很是无奈，
笑着说道：“我过还不行吗？”三女一听这才舒口气，洛冰儿温柔说道：“弟弟，今年生辰时间确实晚了点，不过我已经让刘掌柜，把他酒楼的主厨，给请来给你做好吃的了。”姬云生神色复杂的看着她，心里喃喃道：“唉！如今终于能说话了，却不知该如何称呼这便宜姐姐。”
这时一股强大的力量，在姬云生的脑海炸开，顿时他整个人晕了过去，陈晓云见状连忙扶着他，着急温柔问道：“弟弟，你怎么了？你可别吓姐姐啊！”洛冰儿也是连忙过来，运转力量查看起来，只是当她的力量，在姬云生身上游走时，她感觉自己的力量石沉大海一般，
好似被什么力量，给阻挡她查看具体情况了，李雨彤见状疑惑问道：“师尊，弟弟是怎么了？你有查看出来什么了吗？”洛冰儿一听摇摇头，皱起眉头温柔回答道：“没有，我的力量被隔开了，我也不知道到底是什么力量，反正总之很强大。
不过好在这力量并没有恶意，具体只能等弟弟醒来再问了。”两女一听顿时舒口气，这时，姬云生睁开眼疑惑的看着周围，他发现目前出现，在一片金色海洋之上，除了他自己外，还有这什么都没有的海洋，顿时有些害怕起来了。这时，一道分不清男女的声音响起：“
恭喜宿主绑定最强歌王系统，请问宿主是否选择，获取新手大礼包一份。”姬云生一听愣了下，疑惑警惕又生气问道：“你是系统？”那道身影一听，强忍笑意平静回答道：“是的，宿主。”姬云生一听缓口气，顿时那害怕之意也消失了，心里却喃喃道：“
卧槽了，你跟我闹着玩呢？我这他喵的，在的是修仙者的世界，你给我来个最强歌王系统，确定不是来搞我的？”那道声音一听顿时不乐意了，有些生气说道：“臭小子，给脸不要脸是吧，就这么嫌弃我？”然后一道带着面具，看不清容貌，黑色古装也看不出性别的身影，白色长发及腰，一米六的身高，
缓缓出现在他眼前，姬云生顿时吓了一跳，有些紧张不敢相信问道：“你是系统？还有这里是哪里？是不是你带我来的这个世界？你为什么要带我来这个世界？”曦回答道：“你这臭小子，怎么？还想和我动手不成？这里是你自己的识海，我带你来这个世界自有道理，
你现在还没有资格知道。对了，我叫曦，也是你所认为的系统，以后再外人面前，我就是你的师尊了，知道了吗？臭小子！”姬云生一听愣住了，过了一会儿，缓口气笑着问道：“那个，你说的xi字是哪个字？”曦没好气回答道：“晨曦的曦字，没大没小，叫师尊！”
然后抬起手敲了下他的脑袋，不过倒是没有用多大力，姬云生一听，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，这到底是个什么情况啊？我到底要不要认她为师尊呢？对方长什么样，是男还是女的，看也看不出来，听也听不出来，性格如何也不知道，对方为什么会看中我呢？”
曦一听有些生气说道：“臭小子，你是不是欠收拾？别以为我不知道你心中所说，你在乱说，信不信我再让你修为封印起来。还有就是以后，你该知道的时候会知道的，有些事情你如今的修为，还没有知道的资格懂了吗？”

Chapter 25 The Strongest Singer System (Page 1)
After a while, Chen Xiaoyun's crying gradually became quieter, and Ji Yunsheng asked with a smile: "Sister, are you here to see me for anything? I was planning to go back, but if things are urgent, I'll go and do things first." Upon hearing this, Chen Xiaoyun raised his head, wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes, and replied with a gentle smile: "Brother, have you forgotten,
Did you agree to prepare the day for your birthday today? "Ji Yunsheng was stunned for a moment, smiled awkwardly and replied: "Uh, sister, I did forget it. But, sister, forget about the birthday! I'm old enough that I don't need to live it every year. When the three women heard this, they all said softly in unison: "No!" "Ji Yunsheng shook his head helplessly after hearing this.
Smiling and saying, "Isn't it okay for me?" After hearing this, the three girls breathed a sigh of relief. Luo Bing'er said softly, "Brother, my birthday is indeed a little late this year, but I have asked shopkeeper Liu to invite the chef of his restaurant to prepare delicious food for you." Ji Yunsheng looked at her with a complicated expression and murmured in his heart: "Oh! Now I can finally speak, but I don't know how to call this cheap sister."
At this time, a powerful force exploded in Ji Yunsheng's mind, and he fainted. Seeing this, Chen Xiaoyun quickly supported him and asked anxiously and gently: "Brother, what's wrong with you? Don't scare your sister!" Luo Bing'er also hurriedly came over and used her power to check, but when her power wandered around Ji Yunsheng's body, she felt as if her power had disappeared into the sea.
It seemed that some force prevented her from checking the specific situation. Li Yutong saw this and asked in confusion: "Master, what's wrong with my brother? Have you found anything out?" Luo Bing'er shook her head when she heard this, frowned and replied softly: "No, my power is separated, and I don't know what kind of power it is. Anyway, it is very powerful.
Fortunately, this power is not malicious. We can only ask for details after my brother wakes up. "When the two women heard this, they immediately breathed a sigh of relief. At this time, Ji Yunsheng opened his eyes and looked around suspiciously. He found that he was currently on a golden ocean, and there was nothing in it except himself. He suddenly became a little scared. At this time, a voice that could not distinguish between male and female sounded: "
Congratulations to the host for binding the most powerful singer system. Please ask the host if you choose to get a gift package for newbies. Ji Yunsheng was stunned for a moment when he heard this. He was confused and alert and asked angrily: "Are you the system?" When the figure heard this, he suppressed a smile and replied calmly: "Yes, host." "As soon as Ji Yunsheng breathed a sigh of relief, his fear suddenly disappeared, but he murmured in his heart: "
Damn it, are you kidding me? Damn me, I live in the world of immortal cultivators. Give me the strongest singer system. Are you sure you are not here to mess with me? The voice immediately became unhappy when he heard it, and said angrily: "You brat, you are so shameless, you dislike me so much?" "Then there was a man wearing a mask. His appearance could not be seen clearly. He was wearing black costume and his gender could not be identified. He had long white hair reaching his waist and was 1.6 meters tall.
Slowly appeared in front of him. Ji Yunsheng was startled. He was a little nervous and couldn't believe it and asked: "Are you the system? Where is this place? Is this the world you brought me to? Why did you bring me to this world?" Xi replied: "What's wrong with you brat? Do you still want to fight me? This is your own sea of consciousness. It makes sense for me to bring you to this world.
You are not qualified to know yet. By the way, my name is Xi, and I am also the system you think of. From now on, I will be your master in front of outsiders, do you understand? Brat! Ji Yunsheng was stunned upon hearing this. After a while, he took a breath and asked with a smile: "Um, what is the word "xi" you said? "Xi replied angrily: "Chen Xi's word "Xi" is either big or small. It's called Master! "
Then he raised his hand and knocked him on the head, but not with much force. When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he murmured in his heart: "Fuck, what on earth is going on? Should I recognize her as my master? I can’t tell what the other person looks like, whether he’s a boy or a girl, I can’t tell by looking at him, I can’t tell by hearing him, and I don’t know what his personality is like. Why would he like me? "
When Xi heard this, he was a little angry and said: "You brat, are you in need of cleaning up? Don't think that I don't know what you are saying. You are talking nonsense. Believe it or not, I will let you cultivate and seal it again. Also, in the future, you will know when you should know. There are some things that you are not qualified to know due to your current cultivation level. Do you understand? "
